paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between "Exp. Length" and "Attention Weights," aiming to display how attention weights vary across different experimental lengths. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled as "Exp. Length," with units ranging from 5 to 35, marked in increments of 5. The vertical axis is labeled "Attention Weights," with a linear scale ranging from 0.20 to 0.45, marked at intervals of 0.05. The chart presents six blue bars, each corresponding to an experimental length category with labels at the base: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30. The approximate values of these bars are 0.375, 0.41, 0.415, 0.36, 0.32, and 0.34, respectively. The bars show no particular sorting order, and none of the bars are visually emphasized differently from others.
